name: ado
description: Azure DevOps operations - PRs, pipelines, policies, builds, variable groups, environments, feeds, branches, work items, comments. This skill should be used when the user asks to "create a PR", "list pipelines", "run a pipeline", "check build status", "debug failed pipeline", "create a policy", "add reviewers", "create a work item", "update a task", "list environments", "approve a pipeline", "manage variable groups", "delete a branch", "comment on a PR", "review PR comments", "comment on work items", "resolve PR thread", "code suggestion", or mentions Azure DevOps, ADO, or az devops CLI. Uses az CLI with PAT auth.
